registryEntry.label: Deploy WPA2-Enterprise WiFi Profile via Intune
registryEntry.set_command: $created = Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Method POST -Uri 'https://graph.microsoft.us/v1.0/deviceManagement/deviceConfigurations' -Body (@{'@odata.type'='#microsoft.graph.windowsWifiConfiguration';displayName='CMMC-WiFi-Secure';wifiSecurityType='wpa2Enterprise';networkName='CUI-Network';ssid='{wifiSsid}'} | ConvertTo-Json) -ContentType 'application/json'; Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Method POST -Uri "https://graph.microsoft.us/v1.0/deviceManagement/deviceConfigurations/$($created.id)/assign" -Body (@{assignments=@(@{target=@{'@odata.type'='#microsoft.graph.groupAssignmentTarget';groupId='{cuiGroupId}'}})} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10) -ContentType 'application/json' | Out-Null; $created | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10
